Getting comfortable with Git version control and Quarto for building a reproducible blog.




What I didWhat I learnedUseful links



Getting used to git version control
Creating an initial blog with Quarto




git clone — clone a repo from a GitHub link
git checkout -b "branch_name" — create your own branch
Modify the required file, save it, and then check the status of your repo
git status — check what’s changed
git diff — see the actual differences
git add .
git commit -m "message"
git push
git fetch origin — pull down another branch’s info
git merge origin/branch_name
Repeat: modify → save → add → commit → push

Welcome to my blog!
In this blog, you can trace my learning journey in reproducible research course. Each post will be a summary of what I have learned throughout the specific day of the course. I will also share some of my thoughts and important points for the future references.
